item.title: India’s Russia imports plunge as crude purchases fall, official data shows
item.description: India’s merchandise imports from Russia fell 40.5% in January to $2.86 bn, down from $4.81 bn a year ago, official data shows — largely driven by a sharp cut in Russian crude purchases by Indian refiners.

item.title: Grabbing breasts, pulling pyjama string is 'attempt to rape', says SC setting aside Allahabad high court order
item.description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday overturned a controversial March 2025 ruling of the Allahabad High Court, which had held that grabbing a minor girl’s breasts and dragging her beneath a culvert did not amount to an attempt to rape.

item.title: Its good news at Kuno: Cheetah Gamini births three cubs, numbers go up to 38
item.description: Three new cubs born to cheetah Gamini at Kuno National Park mark a triumphant moment for India’s Project Cheetah. India’s cheetah population now stands at 38—showcasing a historic win for conservation

item.title: Congress cites OCCRP report to renew allegations over Adani Group stakes
item.description: Congress cites a report by the Organised Crime and Corruption Reporting Project to allege benami funds were used by associates to build large stakes in the Adani Group, renewing its demand for a JPC probe into the conglomerate.

item.title: Election Commission announces Rajya Sabha poll schedule for 37 seats
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) on Wednesday unveiled the timetable for biennial elections to the Rajya Sabha, with 37 seats across 10 states set to fall vacant in April 2026.

item.title: NIA arrests absconding PFI accused at Kochi airport after four years
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested a man accused in an alleged arms training case linked to the banned Popular Front of India (PFI), ending a nearly four-year manhunt.

item.title: Expo hours extended amid VIP visit chaos, robodog controversy at India AI Summit
item.description: Expo hours extended till 8pm at the India AI Impact Summit citing “huge enthusiasm” — even as access stays restricted due to VIP movement and PM Narendra Modi’s visit. Chaos first, curbs later.

item.title: DGCA proposes 30-day flying ban power for airlines over unruly passengers
item.description: Airlines could soon get the power to slap a 30-day flying ban on unruly passengers without waiting for committee clearance, under new proposals by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation

item.title: Rahul Gandhi brands AI Summit a ‘PR spectacle’, alleges display of Chinese products
item.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Wednesday launched a sharp attack on the India-AI Impact Summit 2026, describing it as a “disorganised PR spectacle” and alleging that Chinese-made products were being showcased as Indian innovations.

item.title: Around 15 lakh devotees expected at Hind-Di-Chadar event in Navi Mumbai
item.description: Nearly 15 lakh people are expected to gather in Navi Mumbai later this month for a two-day ‘Hind-Di-Chadar’ commemoration marking the 350th martyrdom anniversary of Guru Tegh Bahadur, officials said on Wednesday.
